SFP.Highlight.Name: Speaker highlight
SFP.Highlight.Hint: Draws a glowing frame around whoever is speaking.
SFP.Color.Name: Highlight color
SFP.Color.Hint: Color of the speaking frame, in hex (e.g. #E2B866).
SFP.Width.Name: Frame thickness
SFP.Width.Hint: Thickness of the speaking frame, in pixels.
SFP.Dim.Name: Dim who is not speaking
SFP.Dim.Hint: How much to darken the cameras of people who are not speaking. 0 = off.
SFP.Missing: SnapFrame Premium needs the SnapFrame module installed and enabled.
